steps.message: I’ll inspect the local Maven project to identify the current manifests, dependency versions, and any compile breakages caused by the GraphQL Java 25 upgrade before editing production code.

todos.content: Inspect Maven manifests and current dependency coordinates
Apply dependency groupId/version upgrade in production manifests
Build project to identify source incompatibilities
Update production code for GraphQL Java 25 compatibility
Run verification build/tests without modifying tests
